title: Prosperity feels different when it serves a life you actually want
intro: A reflection on ambition, money, service, and choosing momentum that has meaning.

sections.heading: Define enough
sections.body: A clear definition of enough protects your energy from endless urgency.

sections.heading: Make the next move visible

sections.heading: Build with care
sections.body: Growth should protect your health, relationships, and values too.
